Smart Study Tools

Real tools that check your English — instantly, free, right here

Every tool below runs entirely in your browser — no account, no waiting, nothing leaves your device. Each one covers a clear, honest set of patterns and words, and tells you plainly when something is outside its built-in coverage instead of guessing.

Checks subject–verb agreement (he go → goes), verb forms (he don't → doesn't), double negatives, articles (a apple → an apple), capital letters, your/you're, their/there/they're, its/it's, to/too, then/than and spacing.

Honest scope: this checker fixes common, clear-cut mistakes from a built-in rule set. It does not judge style, meaning or complex sentence structure — for that, use the Writing Checker below.

Built-in English → Urdu dictionary of common IELTS and everyday words, each with an example sentence. If a word is not in the list, we will tell you — a meaning is never invented.

A built-in thesaurus of common IELTS-relevant words, each with genuine alternatives you can use to vary your writing and speaking. If a word is not in the list yet, we will say so.

Get the corrected sentence plus a short list of exactly what was fixed, using the same rule set as the Grammar Checker.

Words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, average sentence length, reading time, speaking time and your most repeated words — counted exactly, on the spot.

Paste your writing and this tool flags very basic words and offers stronger Band 7+ alternatives from a built-in list. The final choice always depends on your sentence — these are options to consider, not automatic replacements.

Word of the Day

One useful IELTS word every day, from the built-in dictionary — with its Urdu meaning, example and alternative words where available. The word changes daily; come back tomorrow for a new one.

Vocabulary Quiz — flashcards

Ten quick questions from the built-in dictionary: read the English word, choose the correct Urdu meaning. Instant right/wrong feedback and a score at the end — your result is saved to your History.

Writing Checker

Not just a score — a better line-by-line version too

Paste your essay below or load the sample. Know how IELTS is checked: trained human examiners mark Writing against four criteria — Task Response, Coherence & Cohesion, Vocabulary and Grammar. This checker follows the same examiner-style framing, so you can fix every sentence before the real test.

0 words

Topic: Some people think technology makes communication easier. Others think it makes it more difficult. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

How it works: write at least 80 words and press Check. You receive an overall score on your exam's scale, four criteria scores, and line-by-line improvements — each with a stronger model version of the sentence.
—
Overall Score

Write an essay and press “Check”

AI scores you on 4 criteria

Line-by-line improvements (sample)

Technology has changed the way people communicate in modern society.
✓ Technology has fundamentally transformed how people communicate in contemporary society.

Why: “fundamentally transformed” and “contemporary” are Band 7+ vocabulary.

Also, misunderstandings happen more in text messages
✓ Moreover, misunderstandings occur more frequently in text-based communication

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 7 October 2026. This policy explains what Engowra collects, why, and the choices you have.

Who we are

Engowra is an online preparation platform for IELTS, PTE, TOEFL, the Oxford Test of English and LanguageCert. You can contact us about privacy at any time via the Contact page.

Information we collect

Guest information stored in your browser: when you use Engowra as a guest, your name, chosen exam, target score, test history, streak and XP are stored only in your own browser's local storage. This never leaves your device unless you create an account, and you can erase it at any time with the “Clear history” button or by clearing your browser data.
Account information: if you subscribe to a paid plan, we collect your name and email address so we can operate your account and sync your history across devices.
Practice content: essays and answers you submit for checking are processed to generate your score and feedback.
Technical information: standard server logs (such as IP address, browser type and pages visited) used to keep the service secure and reliable.

How we use your information

We use your information to run your dashboard and study plan, score your practice and show feedback, save your history, operate paid subscriptions, prevent abuse, and improve the quality of our practice material. We do not sell your personal information.

Cookies and local storage

Engowra uses local storage in your browser to remember your guest profile and history between visits. If you create an account, essential cookies keep you signed in. We do not use advertising trackers that follow you across unrelated websites.

Service providers

We use reputable infrastructure providers to host the website and database (currently Render for hosting and Supabase for the database). They process data only to provide those services to us.

Your choices

You can use almost all of Engowra without an account. You may clear your guest history at any time from the History section, and account holders may ask us to delete their account and associated data via the Contact page.

Security and retention

We protect accounts with encrypted connections and access controls, and we keep account data only for as long as your account is active or as needed to meet legal obligations. Guest data stays on your device under your control.

Children

Engowra is designed for exam candidates and older students. If you believe a child has provided us personal information, contact us and we will remove it.

Changes to this policy

If we change this policy, we will post the new version on this page and update the date above. Continued use of Engowra after a change means you accept the updated policy.

The service

Engowra provides original practice material, mock-style tests, study plans and feedback tools for IELTS, PTE, TOEFL, the Oxford Test of English and LanguageCert. Engowra is an independent preparation platform and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any official exam body.

Guest access and accounts

Most of Engowra is open to guests without registration. Creating an account is free: it saves your profile and test history to your account so they sync across your devices. Paid subscriptions are optional upgrades with extra features. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials secure and for activity under your account.

Subscriptions

Paid plans are billed for the period shown at checkout. Plan features, prices and renewal terms are displayed before you pay; if anything is unclear, contact us before subscribing.

Scores are estimates

Every band, score and level shown on Engowra is a practice estimate generated from your answers. It is not an official result, and we do not guarantee any particular outcome in a real examination.

Our content and your content

All practice passages, questions, model answers and explanations on Engowra are original material written for this platform and remain our intellectual property; you may use them for your personal preparation only. Exam names such as IELTS, PTE, TOEFL, Oxford Test of English and LanguageCert are trademarks of their respective owners. Essays and answers you write remain yours; you give us permission to process them to provide scores and feedback.

Acceptable use

Do not copy or redistribute our practice material commercially, attempt to disrupt or gain unauthorised access to the service, or use Engowra for unlawful purposes.

Availability and liability

We work to keep Engowra available and accurate, but the service is provided “as is” without warranties of uninterrupted operation. To the fullest extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the twelve months before a claim.

About

About Engowra

One platform for the five English exams our learners ask for most — built around how each exam really works.

What Engowra is

Engowra brings IELTS, PTE, TOEFL, the Oxford Test of English and LanguageCert into a single, guest-friendly platform. Choose your exam at the top and everything adapts: the types and modules, today's plan, the practice topics and the scoring scale. There is no sign-up wall — you start learning immediately. An account is free and simply saves your progress to your account; a paid plan is only an optional upgrade.

How each exam is checked — and how you prepare

Exams differ in who (or what) awards the score, so preparation should differ too:
• IELTS — Human-Based: trained human examiners rate Writing and Speaking. Preparation here is examiner-style: criteria-based feedback in the same framework an examiner uses.
• LanguageCert — Human-Based: a live human interlocutor runs Speaking and human markers rate Writing, so you practise live-style conversation and marked writing tasks.
• Oxford Test of English — Human-Based: human assessors rate Speaking and Writing; modules can be taken separately, and preparation mirrors that flexibility.
• PTE — AI-Based: the whole test is scored by AI, so practice is timed, integrated and AI-scored in the same way.
• TOEFL — AI + Human (Hybrid): AI and human raters score together, so practice covers both machine-scored drills and human-rated criteria.

How learning works here

Take the free 2-minute level test, tell us your target, and Engowra builds your plan: a daily exam, skill practice in every module, streaks and XP to keep you consistent, and a leaderboard to benchmark your progress. Every practice set follows the real exam pattern — timing, question types and score scale — and includes an answer key with explanations.

Content standards

Every passage, question, model answer and explanation on Engowra is written originally for this platform, to the pattern and difficulty of the real exams. We never reproduce copyrighted test material or book content.

Platform

Engowra's data model mirrors a production database with profiles, exams, exam types, modules, tests, questions, attempts and subscriptions, hosted with managed infrastructure (Render hosting, Supabase database) for the engowra.com domain. Only public configuration is ever exposed in the browser. Questions about the platform? Visit the Contact page.
